name: Indian (Vedic) sky
summary: The 28 lunar mansions (nakshatras) of the Vedic tradition, the 12 zodiac signs (rashis), and figures such as the Seven Sages or the Deer Hunter.

Aśv.name: The Horsemen
Aśv.description: The name means “possessing horses”. Two stars of Aries (Sheratan and Mesarthim). Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Bhar.name: The Bearer
Bhar.description: Three faint stars of Aries. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Kṛt.name: The Cutters
Kṛt.description: The Pleiades. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Roh.name: The Red One
Roh.description: The reddish Aldebaran in Taurus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Mṛg.name: The Deer’s Head
Mṛg.description: Three faint stars in the head of Orion. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

MṛVy.name: The Deer Hunter
MṛVy.description: Sirius and the stars of Canis Major: the hunter who takes aim at the deer (the head of Orion).

Inv.name: The Arrow
Inv.description: The three stars of Orion’s Belt: the arrow shot by the hunter, flying towards the deer.

Śara.name: The Reed Thicket
Śara.description: Two faint stars on the border of Orion and Gemini: a reed thicket, a reed grove.

Ārd.name: The Moist One
Ārd.description: The reddish Betelgeuse in Orion. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

PVas.name: The Restorers of Goods
PVas.description: The two bright stars of Gemini, Castor and Pollux. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Puṣ.name: The Nourisher
Puṣ.description: Two faint stars of the constellation Cancer. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Aśl.name: The Embrace
Aśl.description: The head of Hydra. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Magh.name: The Bountiful One
Magh.description: The bright star of Leo, Regulus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

PPhā.name: The First Fruitful One
PPhā.description: Two stars on the back of Leo (Zosma and Chertan). Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

UPhā.name: The Second Fruitful One
UPhā.description: Denebola at the tail of Leo and its neighbour. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Hasta.name: The Hand
Hasta.description: The five stars of the constellation Corvus: an outstretched hand. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Chitr.name: The Brilliant One
Chitr.description: The bright star of Virgo, Spica. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Svā.name: The Self-Moving One
Svā.description: The bright star of Boötes, Arcturus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Viś.name: The Branching One
Viś.description: The stars of the constellation Libra. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Anur.name: Follower of Radha
Anur.description: Three stars in the head of Scorpius. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Jyeṣ.name: The Eldest
Jyeṣ.description: The reddish Antares and its two neighbours in the heart of Scorpius. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Mūl.name: The Root
Mūl.description: The curving tail of Scorpius with the stinger. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

PAṣ.name: The First Invincible One
PAṣ.description: Two stars of Sagittarius. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

UAṣ.name: The Second Invincible One
UAṣ.description: Two stars of Sagittarius (Nunki and Ascella). Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

PBhā.name: The First Blessed Feet
PBhā.description: The two western stars of the Square of Pegasus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

UBhā.name: The Second Blessed Feet
UBhā.description: The two eastern stars of the Square of Pegasus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Abh.name: The Victorious One
Abh.description: The bright Vega in Lyra. A member of the old list of 28 lunar mansions, dropped from the later list of 27.

Śra.name: The Ear
Śra.description: The bright star of Aquila, Altair, and its two neighbours. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Dhani.name: The Wealthiest One
Dhani.description: Two stars of Delphinus. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Śata.name: Hundred Healers
Śata.description: One of the stars of Aquarius. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Rev.name: The Wealthy One
Rev.description: One of the faint stars of Pisces. Nakshatra (lunar mansion): one of the 27 (formerly 28) divisions of the ecliptic, each crossed by the Moon in about a day.

Meṣa.name: The Ram
Meṣa.description: The constellation Aries. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Vṛṣa.name: The Bull
Vṛṣa.description: The constellation Taurus. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Mith.name: The Pair
Mith.description: The constellation Gemini. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Kark.name: The Crab
Kark.description: The constellation Cancer. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Simh.name: The Lion
Simh.description: The constellation Leo. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Kany.name: The Maiden
Kany.description: The constellation Virgo. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Tulā.name: The Scales
Tulā.description: The constellation Libra. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Vṛśc.name: The Scorpion
Vṛśc.description: The constellation Scorpius. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Dhan.name: The Bow
Dhan.description: The constellation Sagittarius. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Makr.name: The Makara
Makr.description: The constellation Capricornus, in Indian tradition a crocodile-like water creature. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Kumbh.name: The Pitcher
Kumbh.description: The constellation Aquarius. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Mīna.name: The Fish
Mīna.description: The constellation Pisces. Rashi: one of the twelve 30-degree signs of the zodiac; the names of the months of the solar year come from them.

Shim.name: The Celestial Dolphin
Shim.description: The winding row of stars of Draco: a river dolphin around the celestial pole.

R̥kṣa.name: The Bear
R̥kṣa.description: The whole constellation of the Great Bear.

Sapt.name: The Seven Sages
Sapt.description: The seven stars of the Plough, the seven Vedic sages (rishis), one of the best-known figures of Indian tradition.

Sāra.name: The Charioteer
Sāra.description: The pentagon of the constellation Auriga with the bright Capella.

Tri.name: Trishanku
Tri.description: The Southern Cross: according to the legend, King Trishanku wanted to enter heaven in his own body and was left stranded halfway, in the sky. Not visible from Hungary.

Yam.name: The Yamuna River
Yam.description: The long winding row of stars of Eridanus: one of the sacred rivers of India.
